After the agreed changes are implemented, the system does not
become “error-free.” The dominant causes simply stop obscuring the others.
Part of the next level existed before but was hidden; part emerges
after previous constraints are removed and the process begins
NOT A ONE-TIME CHECK, BUT A CYCLE
It is like climbing: from a new height, the next summit becomes visible.
It is useful to review the full map at least once a year. But if the main changes
have been implemented and the result stabilizes earlier, there is no need
to wait for the calendar date — the next audit can be conducted
Eliminating root causes does not complete improvement. It
